```{=html}
<style>
.w075 { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.9rem; }
.w075 .w075-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
.w075 .w075-q { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }
.w075 .w075-label { font-weight: 600; }
.w075 .w075-in {
  max-width: 280px; padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.9rem;
  border: 2px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222);
}
.w075 .w075-in.w075-right { border-color: #2e7d32; }
.w075 .w075-in.w075-wrong { border-color: #d81e2e; }
.w075 .w075-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w075 .w075-controls button {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w075 .w075-note { font-size: 0.78rem; opacity: 0.7; font-style: italic; }
.w075 .w075-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w075 .w075-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w075 .w075-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
.w075 .w075-expl { font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: 0.85; border-left: 3px solid #2e7d32; padding: 6px 10px; margin-top: 8px; }
</style>
<div class="w075 iw" id="w075">
  <div class="w075-list"></div>
  <div class="w075-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w075-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w075-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w075-solution iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w075-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w075-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
  <div class="w075-expl iw-expl" hidden>
    Static credentials are long-lived secrets such as API keys embedded in code or configuration &mdash; a permanent gift to an attacker who reads the repository &mdash; so the Guidance recommends eliminating them and granting elevated access just in time: requested for a session, approved, and revoked when it ends. The management plane controls everything, so administrative access to it gets the strongest treatment: MFA without exception, least privilege, and logins restricted by location where possible &mdash; see <a href="#sec-07-credentials-management-plane">the section on credentials and the management plane</a>.
  </div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w075');
  const list = root.querySelector('.w075-list');
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w075-msg');
  const expl = root.querySelector('.w075-expl');
  const QS = [
    {
      q: '1. Long-lived secrets such as API keys embedded in code or configuration — a permanent gift to an attacker who reads the repository — are called … credentials:',
      accept: ['static'],
      canon: 'static'
    },
    {
      q: '2. Elevated access that is requested for a session, approved, and revoked when the session ends is granted … (three words, or the acronym):',
      accept: ['just in time', 'jit'],
      canon: 'just in time (JIT)'
    },
    {
      q: '3. The Internet-facing console and API that control the whole infrastructure — and therefore get MFA without exception — form the … plane:',
      accept: ['management'],
      canon: 'management'
    }
  ];
  function norm(s) {
    return (s || '').toLowerCase().replace(/[-_.,;:!?'"()]/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  }
  function inputs() { return [...root.querySelectorAll('.w075-in')]; }
  function clearMarks() {
    inputs().forEach(i => i.classList.remove('w075-right', 'w075-wrong'));
    msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w075-msg iw-msg';
  }
  QS.forEach((it, i) => {
    const q = document.createElement('div');
    q.className = 'w075-q';
    const lab = document.createElement('label');
    lab.className = 'w075-label';
    lab.textContent = it.q;
    lab.setAttribute('for', 'w075-in-' + i);
    const inp = document.createElement('input');
    inp.type = 'text';
    inp.id = 'w075-in-' + i;
    inp.className = 'w075-in';
    inp.dataset.k = String(i);
    inp.autocomplete = 'off';
    inp.addEventListener('input', clearMarks);
    q.appendChild(lab); q.appendChild(inp);
    list.appendChild(q);
  });
  root.querySelector('.w075-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    let right = 0, empty = 0;
    inputs().forEach(inp => {
      inp.classList.remove('w075-right', 'w075-wrong');
      const v = norm(inp.value);
      if (!v) { empty++; return; }
      const acc = QS[Number(inp.dataset.k)].accept;
      const hit = acc.some(a => v === a || (' ' + v + ' ').indexOf(' ' + a + ' ') !== -1);
      if (hit) { inp.classList.add('w075-right'); right++; }
      else inp.classList.add('w075-wrong');
    });
    if (right === QS.length) { msg.textContent = '✓ All correct — no permanent key exists to steal.'; msg.className = 'w075-msg iw-msg ok'; }
    else if (empty > 0 && right + empty === QS.length) { msg.textContent = 'Keep going — ' + empty + ' answer(s) still empty.'; msg.className = 'w075-msg iw-msg'; }
    else { msg.textContent = '✗ Not yet — ' + right + ' of ' + QS.length + ' answers are right; the red ones need another look at the chapter.'; msg.className = 'w075-msg iw-msg bad'; }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w075-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    inputs().forEach(i => { i.value = ''; });
    clearMarks();
    expl.hidden = true;
  });
  root.querySelector('.w075-solution').addEventListener('click', () => {
    inputs().forEach(inp => {
      inp.value = QS[Number(inp.dataset.k)].canon;
      inp.classList.remove('w075-wrong');
      inp.classList.add('w075-right');
    });
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown — reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.className = 'w075-msg iw-msg ok';
    expl.hidden = false;
  });
})();
</script>
```
